verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is Claude's core interaction model. The docs show users prompting in plain language to generate Excel/PowerPoint/Word/PDF files, building artifacts "by simply describing what you need," describing outcomes or recurring tasks for Cowork to execute, having Claude click, type and operate the browser or computer, and holding full spoken conversations in voice mode. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language control across these agentic features (community items are largely about model quality or unrelated topics), and voice mode is still beta.
